006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidArgumentFunctionException;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016
017import java.util.List;
018
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
023 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-exactly-one">fn:exactly-one</a>
024 * function.
025 */
026public final class FnExactlyOne {
027  private static final String NAME = "exactly-one";
028  @NonNull
029  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
030      .name(NAME)
031      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
032      .deterministic()
033      .contextIndependent()
034      .focusIndependent()
035      .argument(IArgument.builder()
036          .name("arg")
037          .type(IItem.type())
038          .zeroOrMore()
039          .build())
040      .returnType(IItem.type())
041      .returnOne()
042      .functionHandler(FnExactlyOne::execute)
043      .build();
044
045  private FnExactlyOne() {
046    // disable construction
047  }
048
049  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
050  @NonNull
051  private static ISequence<?> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
052      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
053      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
054      IItem focus) {
055    return fnExactlyOne(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Check that the provided sequence has exactly one item.
060   * <p>
061   * Based on the XPath 3.1 <a href=
062   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-exactly-one">fn:exactly-one</a>
063   * function.
064   *
065   * @param sequence
066   *          the sequence to evaluate
067   * @return the sequence if it has zero or one items
068   * @throws InvalidArgumentFunctionException
069   *           with the code
070   *           {@link InvalidArgumentFunctionException#INVALID_ARGUMENT_EXACTLY_ONE}
071   *           if the sequence contains less or more than one item
072   */
073  @NonNull
074  public static ISequence<?> fnExactlyOne(@NonNull ISequence<?> sequence) {
075    if (sequence.size() != 1) {
076      throw new InvalidArgumentFunctionException(
077          InvalidArgumentFunctionException.INVALID_ARGUMENT_EXACTLY_ONE,
078          String.format("fn:exactly-one called with the sequence '%s' containing a number of items other than one.",
079              sequence.toSignature()));
080    }
081    return sequence;
082  }
083}
